summary: Iteration 9 frontend testing (admin vs regular UX). All requested flows verified on the preview URL. Regular user sees strictly read-only content across playground summary, playground detail, curriculum, code viewer, schematic and code editor. Admin user (special onboarding name) sees inline edit inputs/textareas for module title/focus, tutorial copy (Do/See/Break/Understand), per-line code explanation, code itself via react-simple-code-editor, schematic upload/clear, curriculum lesson name/description, and section title/description. Overrides persist under localStorage 'embedded-for-kids-overrides' across reload. LiveEditor now starts EMPTY for everyone, drafts persist per module id under 'embedded-for-kids-code-drafts', Reset empties the editor. Profile popover shows 'Herendra (admin)' + admin note only for admin. All previously working features (sidebar navigation, live search, donation modal, tutorial tabs, IDF-style monitor tab, terminal tab, hardware baud/connect/flash/status) still function. No page errors observed on either flow.

issues: Sidebar lesson names are read directly from curriculumData; when an admin renames a lesson via [data-testid=lesson-name-editable] the sidebar continues to show the original name after reload (main content shows override correctly). Not in spec; minor consistency polish only.

critical_code_review_comments: useAdmin uses window.localStorage in useState initializer without SSR guard — fine for CRA, watch out if migrated to Next.js.
overrides.js has no schema/versioning; if data model changes in future, migrations may be needed to avoid stale keys.
Sidebar could optionally consume resolveField() so admin lesson name overrides propagate consistently to the sidebar view (cosmetic).
seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage 'embedded-for-kids-profile' with both regular and admin profiles across test flows. No backend seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Admin gate is name-based via useAdmin hook and 'embedded-profile-change' custom event dispatched by App.js on profile set/reset. All admin edits live in localStorage key 'embedded-for-kids-overrides' via utils/overrides.js. Code drafts live in 'embedded-for-kids-code-drafts' via LiveEditor.jsx and are EMPTY by default (module.code no longer seeds the editor). To exercise curriculum edits you must first click a real lesson from the sidebar (e.g., 'Mikrokontroler'); the initial welcome view intentionally renders a plain

for lesson-intro because hasSelectedLesson is false.
